### 1. Scene
A tray meal with roast poultry, mixed cooked vegetables, fruit salad, a yellow drink, a bottle containing brown sauce or gravy, and a wrapped ice-cream bar.

### 2. Vessels
- Poultry plate: approximately **22 cm** diameter; area **380 cm²**.
- Vegetable side plate: approximately **20 cm**; area **314 cm²**.
- Fruit bowl: approximately **12 cm**; opening area **113 cm²**.
- Drink glass: approximately **7 cm** diameter.
- Sauce bottle: approximately **5 cm** internal diameter near the bottom.

### 3–7. Items, coverage, volume, weight, and energy
The poultry appears to include pale breast slices and a darker, skin-on portion. No separate oil or dressing is clearly visible.

| Item | Vessel coverage | Gross volume calculation | Density | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Roast poultry breast slices | 40% of main plate | 380 × 40% × 0.95 cm = 144 ml | 0.95 | 137 | 155 | 212 |
| Darker skin-on roast poultry | 20% of main plate | 380 × 20% × 1 cm = 76 ml | 0.95 | 72 | 230 | 166 |
| Mixed carrots, corn, broccoli and green vegetables | 60% of side plate | 314 × 60% × 1.5 cm = 283 ml | 0.60 | 170 | 55 | 94 |
| Mixed fruit, mostly melon with a few grapes | 85% of bowl opening | 113 × 85% × 2 cm = 192 ml | 0.60 | 115 | 40 | 46 |
| Yellow drink, assumed juice | Full glass cross-section | 38.5 cm² × 5.7 cm = 219 ml | 1.0 | 220 | 45 | 99 |
| Brown sauce/gravy in bottle | Bottom cross-section | 19.6 cm² × 2.3 cm = 45 ml | 1.0 | 45 | 70 | 32 |
| Wrapped chocolate-coated ice cream, inferred from packaging | Not applicable | Approx. 100 ml bar envelope | 0.75 | 75 | 310 | 233 |

Coverage check: the two poultry portions together cover approximately **60%** of their plate; vegetables cover **60%** of theirs; fruit fills approximately **85%** of the bowl opening.

### 8. Sanity check
Estimated total: **934 g and 882 kcal**, including the drink, sauce and packaged dessert. The plated poultry, vegetables and fruit alone total approximately **494 g**, which is plausible for the visible portions. The packaged dessert and drink identity are the largest uncertainties.
